correctness.rationale: For deg a>=2, the filtered-domain degree equation forces every isotropy automorphism to be affine linear; leading-form factorization then makes it diagonal, and coefficient comparison gives the exact finite root-of-unity subgroup. Iterating the derivation on p proves non-local-finiteness. The lower-degree branches reduce to established normal forms.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 source explicitly leaves the unrestricted Weyl isotropy criterion open and does not state the first-order stratum result. Classical automorphism structure is prior art; targeted searches did not locate the exact trichotomy or cyclic stabilizer formula. Implicit older coverage remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves the recent criterion on a natural infinite-dimensional family extending beyond locally finite derivations and upgrades bounded isotropy to an exact finite cyclic classification in the nonlinear coefficient case.
